requirements: Use only transforms, opacity, and numeric SVG attributes available in the approved core runtime
Path morphing, shape morphing, and stroke drawing require separately approved plugin artifacts and are blocked in Phase 4
The required public GSAP plugin must be present in the approved runtime artifact
Responsive contexts and ScrollTrigger instances must be reverted or killed during cleanup

conflicts.description: GSAP cannot exclusively own the same explicit scope and property as another provider.
